subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: Should ClawHub keep preserving hidden version history after skill deletion, requiring these deleted Huawei skills to republish as 0.0.2, or should deletion gain a hard-delete/version-reset path that allows 0.0.1 reuse?
rationale: The immediate recovery can proceed under today's soft-delete model, but changing version reuse semantics affects audit history, recovery behavior, retention, and publisher expectations.

options.title: Keep Soft-Delete History
options.body: Require the two Huawei skills to republish as 0.0.2 now and document that deletion hides skills without resetting version history.

options.title: Add Explicit Version Reset
options.body: Design a separate owner or operator hard-delete flow with audit logging before allowing version reuse after deletion.

options.title: Purge Versions On Delete
options.body: Automatically removing old versions would match the reuse expectation but weakens audit and recovery history.

recommendation.title: Keep Soft-Delete History
recommendation.body: Require the two Huawei skills to republish as 0.0.2 now and document that deletion hides skills without resetting version history.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the staged-publish recovery thread and asked the explicit delete/version-history product question on this issue.
